module_advisories.advice: Moving from Atlas 3 to Atlas 4 is optional in Mendix 11; the change is SASS variables to CSS variables, and Atlas 4 remains backwards compatible with apps still using SASS variables. If you do migrate, upgrade Atlas Web Content too, and watch for UI modules still reading old Atlas SASS variables -- those usages silently fall back to Atlas defaults rather than failing.
